problems: Program pages were rarely updated: the roster was stale 2010-13, 2014-16 and 2017-19, so 6 of 16 years are reconstructed (bracketed residents only) and residents who finished inside those gaps (Assina, Sinclair, Quinn, Cohen, Crisman, Meleis, Say, Slottje) show as LEFT only because their final years are unseen. 2019-20 onward the roster is a PNG image read by eye (names transcribed manually). 2022-23 only page 1 of a paginated listing archived. 2020-21 joiners (7 residents, 6 DOs with rwjbh.org emails, bios citing residency starts 2015-2018) look like an absorbed RWJBarnabas-affiliated osteopathic neurosurgery program during the AOA->ACGME transition, not individual transfers - phase 2 should confirm and decide whether to treat them as program joiners. Raja Jani conflict (sites listing vs njms image) for 2023-24. Name variants canonicalised: Caminucci->Carminucci, Hershman->Herschman, 'Nick Hernandez'->Robert Hernandez, 'Ali Meybodi-Tayebi'->Ali Tayebi Meybodi. Trong Huynh listed 'PGY 1/2 (Oct 1, 2023)' - off-cycle advancement, recorded at lower PGY. Common Crawl failed (index range/size errors after retries): CC-MAIN-2013-48, 2016-40, 2017-04, 2019-04 (njms.rutgers/umdnj), 2020-05, 2021-43 (sites.rutgers), 2023-14 (njms.rutgers). No program-side alumni page after 2009; no training_history rows inserted. PHASE2: Common Crawl index range failures persisted for CC-MAIN-2014-42, 2016-22 (njms), 2017-43 (umdnj), 2019-18 (njms), 2023-06 (sites.rutgers), 2014-42/2016-26/2017-47 (SBMC paths); SBMC CC scan killed after CC-MAIN-2018-47 (2019-2021 crawls unscanned; Wayback shows no roster page there). OpenAlex rate-limited late in the session.

source_program_absorbed.program: Saint Barnabas Medical Center (Livingston NJ, RWJBarnabas Health; now Cooperman Barnabas) AOA/osteopathic neurosurgery residency (ACOS-approved; affiliated Hackensack UMC)
source_program_absorbed.event: Unified with the NJMS ACGME program for 2020-21 (PD Ira Goldstein bio: SBMC osteopathic residents rotated at University Hospital, then 'an increase in the size of our training program, and ultimately the unification of the residency programs of SBMC and NJMS')
evidence: barnabashealth.org/education/sbmc/neurosurgery/ (Wayback 2011-2012) and rwjbh.org .../saint-barnabas-medical-center/neurosurgery-residency/ (2019): program pages, no resident roster ever published
PubMed: Cummock (2019), Shafiq (2020, 'Department of Neurosurgery, RWJBarnabas Health, Saint Barnabas Medical Center'), Zhao SBMC affiliations
source_program_absorbed.residents_lost: None identified. The SBMC program never published a roster (Wayback 2011-2022, CC 2013-2018 of its pages). Every SBMC neurosurgery resident found in PubMed/Europe PMC 2012-2021 (Cummock, Shafiq, Zhao) moved to NJMS. The 2019 cohort is empty on the merged roster (no PGY2 joiner in 2020-21): SBMC either took no 2019 intern or one left unseen - not observable, and outside program 57 until 2020.
source_program_absorbed.not_from_sbmc: Manan Shah (PGY5 2020-21) is an MD transfer from Wayne State/DMC (program 125, closure) - the 'Kevin Shah' of the crossmatch notes
